title: DeepVoting: Learning and Improving Voting Rules with Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2408.13630v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recently, social choice theory has been found broadly useful for AI alignment and evaluation, often based on the axiomatic properties for combining preferences provided by social choice functions. However, for many sets of axioms, functions which never violate the axioms are known to not exist, e.g., Arrow's Impossibility Theorem. Recent work on learning novel rules to minimize axiom violations shows the effectiveness of machine learning but explores a limited class of axioms. In this work we show the effectiveness of standard social choice data structures as features for learning existing voting rules, resulting in networks that have better accuracy than past approaches while using an order of magnitude fewer parameters. Subsequently, we develop a process for adding axiomatic properties to existing voting rules. By building novel axiomatic loss functions we are able to use transfer learning to fine-tune existing voting rules i

translated_title: DeepVoting：通过微调学习和改进投票规则
translated_abstract: 近年来，社会选择理论被发现对人工智能对齐和评估具有广泛的应用价值，这通常基于社会选择函数所提供的用于组合偏好的公理性质。然而，对于许多公理集合而言，已知不存在永不违反这些公理的函数，例如阿罗不可能定理。最近关于学习新规则以最小化公理违反的研究表明了机器学习的有效性，但仅探索了有限类别的公理。在这项工作中，我们展示了将标准社会选择数据结构作为特征来学习现有投票规则的有效性，所产生的网络比以往方法具有更高的准确率，同时使用的参数数量少了一个数量级。随后，我们开发了一种为现有投票规则添加公理性质的方法。通过构建新颖的公理损失函数，我们能够利用迁移学习对现有的投票规则进行微调。
tldr: 本文提出DeepVoting方法，利用标准社会选择数据结构作为特征学习投票规则，在参数减少一个数量级的同时获得更高的准确率，并通过新颖的公理损失函数和迁移学习微调，为现有投票规则注入所需的公理性质。
